name: llama-modchip

platforms.note: Prebuilt x86_64 binaries for AVX2 and AVX-512 VBMI, or built from source, which also covers ARM64 such as Graviton3
MinGW-w64 UCRT64 build of the patched engine, from windows/build_patched_engine.ps1
Apple silicon; apple-silicon/setup.sh builds the patched engine and the Fractal-64 Q2_0 Metal kernel

Experimental -Cuda switch of windows/build_patched_engine.ps1. install.sh builds no GPU engine, and the CUDA and Vulkan binaries windows/AVVIA_MODCHIP.bat downloads for standard GGUFs are mainline llama.cpp's

install.windows: git clone https://github.com/synchopate/llama-modchip && cd llama-modchip && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows\build_patched_engine.ps1

note: A llama.cpp fork for MoE models on the CPU, with its own quant types: LUT-VQ3-64 is VQ3_0 (3.00 bpw) and decodes only on x86-64 AVX-512 VBMI, while Fractal-64 (3.75 bpw) reuses type 42 with a 30-byte block, so mainline llama.cpp sizes it at 18 and refuses the file. It ships CPU builds and a Metal build, and standard GGUFs still load; neither of its own types has a CUDA or Vulkan shader yet. The installer keeps the server in the clone's workspace/bin, not on PATH, and starts it on port 8789; the JSON API is llama-server's, and the bundled SSE gateway on 8787 adds the Anthropic messages endpoint.
